structured.reason: With the string check disabled, plain string content is treated as a sequence and split into one text part per character. A single text message becomes many parts, which breaks the requirement that normalization preserves the caller's ordered parts and text intent.
sources: Content normalization shall preserve caller order, message role and metadata, media kind, and public descriptor metadata across text, file, image, local-video, and remote-video parts.
Normalizing a ChatMessage preserves role, ordered parts, and metadata values while owning a separate top-level metadata mapping.
structured.test_focus: Normalize a message whose content is a plain multi-character string and check that the result is exactly one text part equal to the original string.
